newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner -Allianz links untouched by merger.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner -Allianz links untouched by merger.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG, Germany's second-largest commercial bank, said on Monday it would continue to pursue strategic links with Allianz AG despite the merger between Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG.
In a brief statement issued in response to enquiries, Dresdner said it welcomed the move by the two Bavarian banks to merge as an important step toward restructuring the German banking system.
"This development does not run counter to the strategic concept which we are discussing with our partner Allianz and which we continue to push forward," the bank said.
Allianz, Germany's largest insurance group, will own 15 percent of the newly merged bank. It owned 21.6 percent of Dresdner as at end-1996.
